text:
B: Hiya! Can you hear me? I'm Aleena, I'm in Swansea.
A: Yeah. Gareth. Basingstoke.
B: Okay, nice. Is this your last one?
A: Er, I thought the last one was. Apparently not.
B: *(laughs)* Sorry to disappoint. Did you do the puzzle thing at the start, the shapes? I'm pretty sure I got them all. I was quick as well.
A: Yeah. That one was alright.
B: Just alright? Okay. What do you do, then?
A: Structural engineer.
B: Like bridges?
A: Warehouses mostly. Retail units. Steel frames.
B: Okay, so is that good money? Sorry, that's blunt, I just always ask. I'm doing Business, so I'm nosy about it.
A: *(pause)* It's alright. Better once you're chartered. I did that late.
B: Why late?
A: Didn't get round to the paperwork. For a few years.
B: Oh my god, years? I'd have done it in a week. I'd be like, give me the money. Sorry. Is that, like, normal for engineers?
A: Not really. Just me.
B: *(laughs)* Fair. I'm at Swansea Uni, first year. My dad's a nurse and my mum's a pharmacy tech, so they wanted me to do nursing or pharmacy, and I was like, no, it's not happening. I want sales. Commission, company car, Manchester or London, where the money is, do you know what I mean.
A: My lad's got his GCSEs next year. He doesn't know what he wants either.
B: Is he revising?
A: Says he is.
B: He's not. I said I was revising for two years and I was on TikTok the whole time. Still got an A in Business, though. Tell him flashcards the night before, that's what I did.
A: *(laughs)* I'll pass that on. Probably not what his teachers want him hearing.
B: Teachers don't know anything. Sorry, no, mine were fine actually. What's he into?
A: Football, mainly. Saints. We go to St Mary's a couple of times a season, me and him.
B: My dad and my brother watch the Swans. I go sometimes, but honestly, I'm there for the chips and the people-watching.
A: Chips are the best bit at St Mary's too, to be fair.
B: See! Is that a school shirt on the airer thing? Have you got another one?
A: Yeah. Ellie. Twelve. She's on TikTok all the time, it's all she talks about.
B: Okay, she's got taste. What's she watching? If she says Love Island, I'll be proud of her.
A: Er, no idea, honestly. Dancing, I think. Something with a dog.
B: You need to find out, that's literally dad homework. Like, ask her tonight. She'll think you're being weird, but she'll secretly love it, yeah?
A: Yeah. Fair. I probably should, to be honest.
B: Do you think you'd—
